newsitem.title: NIGER: Niger government takes control of haj arrangements.
newsitem.headline: Niger government takes control of haj arrangements.

text.p: The government of Niger has taken control of the organisation of the annual Moslem haj pilgrimage to Mecca for its nationals, accusing private operators of focusing more on profit than service.

The move, announced by the interior ministry on Friday, follows two years during which hundreds of Niger Moslems paid for the pilgrimage but could not go because of a lack of planes to fly to Saudi Arabia.

"In a 95 percent Moslem country the state cannot tolerate a repeat of the painful events experienced by pilgrims since 1995 as a result of the amateurism and the lack of care of certain private operators for whom transporting pilgrims is simply a lucrative operation," the interior ministry said.
A statement from the ministry invited citizens of the West African nation who want to take part in the 1997 haj to sign up with their local authorities to give an idea of numbers.
